extDescription.message: A modern Lichess: a roomy layout, playful pages, your own board, pieces and sounds, and a Game Review for every game.
extDescription.description: The extension's summary, shown in chrome://extensions and on the Chrome Web Store (132 characters at most).

sidebarCollapse.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows its labels.

sidebarExpand.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows only its icons.

puzzleMenu.description: The puzzle page's cog, which opens the puzzle's details, its theme and the settings.

settingsLink.description: The account menu's link to the extension's settings.

settingsTitle.description: The title of the extension's settings, on the account page.

settingsIntro.message: The extension's settings. They follow you to every browser you sync with your Google account.
settingsIntro.description: Under the title of the extension's settings.

settingUiSounds.description: The setting that turns the extension's interface sounds on and off.

settingUiSoundsBody.message: Little sounds as you use the extension's controls, like the notches of Stockfish's level slider. Lichess's sounds and your pack's don't change.
settingUiSoundsBody.description: What the interface sounds setting covers.

packsTitle.description: The title of the settings' card for the imported packs.

packsBody.message: Your own board, pieces or sounds, from a pack on GitHub. Once imported, pick them in the user menu, in the Extension tab of Board, Piece set or Sound.
packsBody.description: What the packs card is for.

packsEmpty.description: The packs card, before any import.

packsUnreadable.message: The imported packs could not be read.
packsUnreadable.description: The packs card, when the browser's storage fails.

packsPartPieces.description: A pack holds a piece set.

packsRemove.description: The button that removes an imported pack.

packsLink.message: Link to a pack on GitHub
packsLink.description: The placeholder of the field for a pack's link.

packsImport.description: The button that imports a pack.

packsPrivate.description: Opens the field for a private repository's token.

packsToken.description: The placeholder of the token's field.

packsTokenNote.message: A fine-grained token that can only read this repository’s contents, used for this import and never kept.

packsImported.description: Once a pack is imported; $1 is its name.

packsImportFailed.message: The pack could not be imported.
packsImportFailed.description: An import that failed for an unknown reason.

packsNoLink.message: Paste a link to a pack first.
packsNoLink.description: Import pressed with an empty link.

packsHelp.description: The link to the pack format's guide.

appearanceTitle.description: The title of the settings' card for the color scheme and the color themes.

appearanceBody.message: Light or dark, as in Lichess's own Theme menu, and a color theme for each.
appearanceBody.description: What the appearance card is for.

colorSchemeTitle.description: Above the light, dark and system choices; it's Lichess's own Theme preference.

schemeSystem.description: The color scheme that follows the device's.

themesTitle.description: Above the color themes, each with a light and a dark side to pick.

themeForLight.description: A theme's light side, a button; $1 is the theme's name.

themeForDark.description: A theme's dark side, a button; $1 is the theme's name.

themeReimagined.description: The default color theme: neutral greys and a blue accent.

themeLichess.description: A color theme in Lichess's own warm greys and blue.

themeOcean.description: A color theme in sea blues.

themeGrove.description: A color theme in forest greens.

themeEmber.description: A color theme in warm oranges.

themeMidnight.description: A color theme in deep night blues.

schemeToggleToDark.description: The sidebar's light / dark switch, while the page is light.

schemeToggleToLight.description: The sidebar's light / dark switch, while the page is dark.

themeRuby.description: A color theme in deep reds.

themeDune.description: A color theme in sand and amber.

themeMatcha.description: A color theme in tea greens.

themeFjord.description: A color theme in cold steel blues.

themeMocha.description: A color theme in coffee browns.

themePlum.description: A color theme in plum magentas.

themeTwilight.description: A color theme of a violet dusk with an orange sun: violet greys, an orange accent.

themeCreate.description: Opens the editor for a new color theme.

themeAdd.description: Opens the field to paste a shared theme's code.

themeCopy.description: A built-in theme's copy button; $1 is its name.

themeEdit.description: A theme of the user's, its edit button; $1 is its name.

themeCopyName.description: The name a copied theme starts with; $1 is the original's.

editorNew.description: The theme editor's title, for a new theme.

editorEdit.description: The theme editor's title, for one of the user's themes.

editorName.description: The label of the theme's name field.

editorUntitled.description: The placeholder of the name field, and the name of a theme saved without one.

editorTint.description: The slider of the hue the backgrounds and greys take.

editorStrength.description: The slider of how much the backgrounds and greys take the tint.

editorAccent.description: The color of links, picks and primary buttons.

editorLowContrast.message: White text is hard to read on this accent: try a deeper one.
editorLowContrast.description: Shown when the accent is too light for the white text of buttons.

editorDeleteConfirm.description: The delete button, after a first click.

editorShare.description: Copies the theme's code, to share it.

editorCopied.description: The share button, once the code is copied.

themeCodePlaceholder.description: The field for a shared theme's code.

themeCodeAdd.description: Adds the theme of the pasted code.

themeCodeInvalid.description: When the pasted text isn't a theme's code.

settingSidebarRating.description: The setting of which speed's rating shows beside the player's name in the sidebar.

settingSidebarRatingBody.message: The rating beside your name. By default, the speed you play the most.
settingSidebarRatingBody.description: What the sidebar rating setting covers.

ratingMostPlayed.description: The default pick: the speed with the most games.
